title: Ship ignores a green required check when the ruleset lists a check with a null integration id
body: GitHub returns integration_id null; required-check.ts:109 accepts only number|undefined, parsing throws, the required context falls back to `Check`, and ship exits 69 though `ci / Check` is green (src/repo/required-check.ts:109, 146-152).

Evidence: an external Gemini audit (2026-11-20) wrote the reproduction .krn/runs/gemini-audit/d2-*.test.ts; it fails by assertion on main 1856e2d, and an independent krn-reader pass confirmed the premise and the expected behaviour against the source.
Outcome: the reproduction becomes the regression test at the lowest layer that shows the defect (KRN-14) and passes; the fix names the defect class in Root cause and Redesign lines (KRN-15).

Files: src/repo/required-check.ts, test/repo/required-check.test.ts
Proof: node --test .krn/runs/gemini-audit/d2-ship-ruleset-null.test.ts fails by assertion on the base and passes after the fix
